import os
base='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u020/system/state/workspace/programs'
os.makedirs(base,exist_ok=True)
def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==7]
    # infer direction from two 7s, extend along same vector from most advanced point
    if len(pts)>=2:
        # choose pair with diagonal unit spacing
        pairs=[]
        for i,(r,c) in enumerate(pts):
            for R,C in pts[i+1:]:
                dr,dc=R-r,C-c
                if abs(dr)==abs(dc) and dr:
                    pairs.append((r,c,R,C,dr//abs(dr),dc//abs(dc)))
        if pairs:
            r,c,R,C,dr,dc=pairs[0]
            # advance from R,C in vector toward that point's direction
            while 0<=R+dr<len(g) and 0<=C+dc<len(g[0]):
                R+=dr; C+=dc
                if g[R][C]==1:g[R][C]=7
    return g
grid=[[1]*15 for _ in range(7)]
for r,c,v in [(3,0,7),(3,3,3),(4,1,7),(4,2,3),(5,1,4),(5,2,3)]:grid[r][c]=v
out=transform(grid)
open(base+'/task-926b338c.py','w').write('def transform(grid):\n    g = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    pts = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == 7]\n    if len(pts) >= 2:\n        for i,(r,c) in enumerate(pts):\n            for R,C in pts[i+1:]:\n                dr,dc = R-r,C-c\n                if dr and abs(dr)==abs(dc):\n                    dr//=abs(dr); dc//=abs(dc)\n                    while 0 <= R+dr < len(g) and 0 <= C+dc < len(g[0]):\n                        R+=dr; C+=dc\n                        if g[R][C] == 1: g[R][C]=7\n                    return g\n    return g\n')
print(out)
